digest.component_or_area: ticket store snapshot entries and reducer cache
propositions: Snapshot entries documented as immutable are being mutated by write_cache during ticket reads, creating .cache.json files inside the entry directory post-materialization
The reverify pass treats entries as immutable and records a baseline digest; subsequent reads add .cache.json files, causing the entry to fail reverify checks and be evicted
write_cache writes .cache.json inside snapshot entries via atomic_write in two code paths (reducer/_api.py and reducer/_processors.py), violating the content-addressed immutability guarantee
The reducer cache must be disabled or redirected outside snapshot entries when the tracker root is pinned, since the cache is a rebuildable optimization
